keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Siebe Van der Heyden (Gent) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
keyEvents.shortText: Siebe van der Heyden Yellow Card

keyEvents.text: Rade Krunic (Red Star Belgrade) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Gent 1, Red Star Belgrade 0. Tiago Araújo (Gent) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Matties Volckaert with a headed pass following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Tomás Händel (Red Star Belgrade).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Matej Gashtarov (Red Star Belgrade) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Gent 1, Red Star Belgrade 0.
Second Half begins Gent 1, Red Star Belgrade 0.
Substitution, Gent. Hyllarion Goore replaces Matisse Samoise because of an injury.
Substitution, Red Star Belgrade. Osman Bukari replaces Vasilije Kostov.
Substitution, Red Star Belgrade. Mihailo Ristic replaces Mahmudu Bajo.
Substitution, Gent. Aimé Omgba replaces Abdelkahar Kadri.
Substitution, Red Star Belgrade. Marko Arnautovic replaces Vladimir Lucic.
Stefan Gudelj (Red Star Belgrade) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Gent 1, Red Star Belgrade 1. Matej Gashtarov (Red Star Belgrade) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Tomás Händel.
Substitution, Gent. Ibrahima Cisse replaces Josué Vergara.
Substitution, Gent. Gilles De Meyer replaces Tiago Araújo because of an injury.
Substitution, Gent. Mamadou Diallo replaces Momodou Sonko.
Substitution, Red Star Belgrade. Kim Ye-Geon replaces Mirko Ivanic.
Substitution, Red Star Belgrade. Milos Veljkovic replaces Mihailo Ristic because of an injury.
